evidence: Verified claim: fetchBackend and fetchOpenAiFront in src/backend.ts directly accessed process.env[target.authEnv], bypassing readCredential alias resolution and buildAuthHeaders normalization.
Refactored src/backend.ts to import and use readCredential(target.authEnv, process.env, target.provider) and buildAuthHeaders(key, target.authHeader).
Added unit tests in test/backend.test.ts verifying credential alias resolution for both fetchBackend and fetchOpenAiFront.
Passed full build-free verification suite with `npm run check` (tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit, tsc -p tsconfig.test.json, vitest run - 42 test files, 557 tests passed).
